description.p: Plasma 6 system-tray widget that surfaces the identity and PKI capabilities of any LibreSCRS-supported smart card the moment it is inserted. It is a thin client of the LibreSCRS session agent over D-Bus: all card access and secret entry (PIN/CAN) live in the agent. The widget links no LibreMiddleware, performs no cryptographic operations and holds no secrets of its own.
